name: optionsahoy-iso-nso-rsu-qsbs-tax-optimizer
description: Deterministic US equity-compensation tax optimizer. Six tools cover ISO/AMT exercise scheduling, NSO sell-vs-hold, RSU vest-and-sell, single-stock concentration, protective put / zero-cost collar pricing, and Section 1202 QSBS qualification. Federal plus 50-state plus DC tax math.
